title: Ironhull Ascent
message:
Ironhull Ascent: an original action loop in the manner of Chris Hulsbeck's Turrican and Apidya.
A minor, speed 4, intro / A / B / A'. Drums between the bass notes, inversion arpeggios,
a late vibrato, an echo three rows behind. Sound library presets only.
Source: songs/amiga_ironhull_ascent.gen.js. Rendered and measured, not listened to.
